name: Create a loop

name: Delete a loop
description: Delete a loop Soft delete. DELETE /api/projects/{project_id}/loops/{id}/
context:
DELETE /api/projects/{project_id}/loops/{id}/
Soft delete. Pauses every trigger's schedule. Owner or a project admin only.
Required: id (path); project_id (path) — Project ID of the project you're trying to access. To find the ID of the project, make a call to /api/projects/.

name: List loops
description: List loops List loops visible to the caller: personal loops they own, plus every team loop. GET /api/projects/{project_id}/loops/
context:
GET /api/projects/{project_id}/loops/
List loops visible to the caller: personal loops they own, plus every team loop. The response also carries `max_loops_per_team` and `total_loop_count` so a client can show remaining capacity and disable creation at the cap without hardcoding the limit.
Required: project_id (path) — Project ID of the project you're trying to access. To find the ID of the project, make a call to /api/projects/.
Optional: limit (query) — Number of results to return per page.; offset (query) — The initial index from which to return the results.

name: Update a loop
description: Update a loop Partial update. PATCH /api/projects/{project_id}/loops/{id}/
context:
PATCH /api/projects/{project_id}/loops/{id}/
Partial update. Identity-bearing fields (instructions, repositories, connectors, behaviors, model config, triggers) are owner-only on team loops; name, description, notifications and enable/pause are editable by any team member.
Required: id (path); project_id (path) — Project ID of the project you're trying to access. To find the ID of the project, make a call to /api/projects/.
Optional: body (body)

context:
POST /api/projects/{project_id}/loops/{id}/run/
Manual fire from the UI. Owner-only for personal loops; any team member for team loops.

name: List loop runs
description: List loop runs Run history for a loop, newest first, cursor-paginated. GET /api/projects/{project_id}/loops/{id}/runs/
context:
GET /api/projects/{project_id}/loops/{id}/runs/
Run history for a loop, newest first, cursor-paginated.
Required: id (path); project_id (path) — Project ID of the project you're trying to access. To find the ID of the project, make a call to /api/projects/.
Optional: cursor (query) — Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response's `next_cursor`.; limit (query) — Max results per page (default 50, max 100).; status (query) — Only return runs with this status. Use failed to read errors even when canvas state is unavailable. * `not_started` - Not Started * `queued` - Queued * `in_progress` - In Progress * `completed` - Completed * `failed` - Failed * `cancelled` - Cancelled

name: Replace a loop's skill bundles
description: Replace a loop's skill bundles Replaces the loop's attached skill bundles wholesale: zipped local skills whose contents are seeded into every fired run's sandbox. PUT /api/projects/{project_id}/loops/{id}/skill_bundles/
context:
PUT /api/projects/{project_id}/loops/{id}/skill_bundles/
Replaces the loop's attached skill bundles wholesale: zipped local skills whose contents are seeded into every fired run's sandbox. Send an empty list to detach every skill. Owner-only on team loops, like other identity-bearing configuration.
Required: id (path); project_id (path) — Project ID of the project you're trying to access. To find the ID of the project, make a call to /api/projects/.; body (body)

name: Fire a loop externally
description: Fire a loop externally Authenticated POST trigger for `type=api` triggers. POST /api/projects/{project_id}/loops/{id}/trigger/
context:
POST /api/projects/{project_id}/loops/{id}/trigger/
Authenticated POST trigger for `type=api` triggers. Project secret API key auth (`loop:write` scope), project-wide. Request body (JSON, capped at 64 KB) becomes run context. Send an `Idempotency-Key` header to dedupe retries.
Required: id (path); project_id (path) — Project ID of the project you're trying to access. To find the ID of the project, make a call to /api/projects/.
Optional: body (body)
